text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services is recommending that parking be prohibited from 6:00 p.m. to 6:00 a.m., daily, on the south side of Haimer Avenue, from the west intersection of Giles Court to a point 32 metres west of Wallis Crescent. The proposed changes will deter overnight parking in this area.

The Etobicoke York Community Council: 1. Prohibited parking from 6:00 p.m. one day to 6:00 a.m. of the next following day, on the south side of Haimer Avenue, between Giles Court (west intersection) and a point 32 metres west of Wallis Crescent (east intersection).
